flags.observation: No style text accompanies the candidate; danceable groove, BPM and genre rotation cannot be verified.
Thesis "offshore finance makes the bill somebody else's problem" covers only the BCCI page; drug money, fiat, CBDC and exit cards fall outside it.
Only one onboarding beat; no speaker, no card-game premise. Punch "considerably longer ledger" is vague and needs prior BCCI knowledge; normies miss it.
"BCCI funnel millions" is ungrammatical; source "helped funnel" lost its auxiliary in the cut.
"CIA used BCCI for offshore finance and future enemies" drops the teaching verb; the cut turns the claim into CIA using future enemies.
Opener plus double colon gives 118 characters with two name-like stops before the claim; not one breath.
"After Price Waterhouse" is a temporal and-then link, not therefore/but; same pattern at beat 30 with "After BCCI".
Card verb "washed" dropped; "cartel drug capital through international financial markets" is a verbless fragment, the claim carried only by the name.
One-word labels "Police.", "Doctrine.", "Control.", "Protest." tag topics; none bridges from the previous card by consequence or twist (tips 1 and 2).
Opener micro-arc flatter than the golden take: topic labels at fixed every-third-beat spacing, no escalating sequence across a page.
"socialize all losses across Eurozone" recites the power as a command; same at beat 25 "build exact same panopticon" and beat 28 "expose illusion".
BIS quote collapses into "central bank absolute control": verbless, attribution gone, card punch lost; opener "Control." doubles the word.
Opener "Cashless." repeats the card name; beat 24 "Referendum." and beat 27 "Protest." repeat words already in their card lines.
"dissidents dread" reads as an unfinished verb phrase; source "existential dread for dissidents" loses its sense in the cut.
Subject "Tech-payment monopolies" dropped; "fine customers for spreading misinformation" now sounds like a rule instruction, with "fine" doubled.
Conditional "If Occupy had become" dropped; "world would be different" now floats without its condition, which alters the card's claim.
Isolated "fluffy" between "cash is resistance" and "starve the beast" carries no sense; opener and card name stack two colons.
"Four hundred branches passed through the system": branches act as agents, so the outro setup rests on object-acting.
